source: RentViewer data warehouse (Rent Manager) · roster from Property Data Sheet

flags.title: $12K of receivables rolled in from sub-ledgers
flags.detail: These ledgers are not reportable communities themselves, so their balances are attributed to the parent community rather than shown as their own row: Applegate Water $9K, Vantage Oaks Utility $2K, Northgate Utility $11.

flags.title: 2 sold properties are excluded by override, not by the PDS
flags.detail: Congress Mobile Home Park, Shell Pointe MHC. Correctly out of every figure, but the Property Data Sheet still reads Reportable = Yes with no Sale Date, so the exclusion rests on registry.json rather than the roster. Flipping Reportable to No and filling the Sale Date lets the override be retired.

flags.title: Live receivables run $1.17M above the closed month by design
flags.detail: Rent bills on the 1st, so day 4 of 2026-09 carries a full month of new charges against 4 days of collection. Past the 5th that money is late, which is why the live view exists. Use the Closed toggle to compare like with like.

flags.title: Receivables are 62% against a year ago
The 90+ bucket is up 148% in seven months
flags.detail: $254K to $630K while the monthly collection rate still reads 99.2%. Collections is a flow and receivables are a stock, so a few points of monthly leakage compounds here.

flags.title: 1 community's lot count disagrees with the Property Data Sheet
flags.detail: The PDS is the authoritative lot count, so a gap means the Rent Manager unit list is out of step: Cambridge MHC (PDS 92, RM 149). Occupancy is computed on the warehouse count, so these percentages sit on the wrong denominator until the ledgers agree.

flags.title: 2026-09 financials are not posted yet
flags.detail: Revenue, expenses and NOI have no live figure this early in the month, so the Financials tab and the NOI tile always report closed 2026-08 regardless of the period toggle.

flags.title: 6 communities post revenue with no budget loaded
flags.detail: Budget variance is blank for: Geiger Key RV Resort, Hendersons MHC, Hunter Springs MHP, McGregor Downs, Parkwood Mobile Home Park, Regency I & II.
